import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs';import crypto from 'node:crypto';import test from 'node:test';
import {validateCurrentAtlasDelivery} from './current-atlas-delivery.mjs';import {renderChecklist} from '../scripts/refresh-completion-checklist.mjs';
const root=new URL('../',import.meta.url),base='tests/fixtures/head-masks-before-resource-budget/',read=p=>fs.readFileSync(new URL(p,root)),json=p=>JSON.parse(read(p)),sha=b=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const archive=json(base+'manifest.json'),records=new Map(archive.records.map(row=>[row.path,row])),old=p=>JSON.parse(read(records.get(p).frozenPath));
test('exact41 renderer and original tests are frozen without becoming current admission',()=>{
 assert.equal(sha(read(base+'manifest.json')),'94ad4edb5fd6dfab31b6fe973f84431a85da7e1605eb676b99b611a8b1f2bc3e');assert.equal(records.size,20);
 for(const row of records.values())assert.equal(sha(read(row.frozenPath)),row.sha256,row.path);
 assert.throws(()=>validateCurrentAtlasDelivery({pin:old('tests/fixtures/current-atlas-delivery.json')}));
 for(const p of ['tests/head-comparison-renderer-revision.test.mjs','tests/clinical-review-inbox-navigation-revision.test.mjs'])assert.match(read(p).toString(),/runFrozenHeadMaskEpoch/);
});
test('current closed Review binds every native mask helper without changing Atlas sources',()=>{
 const pin=validateCurrentAtlasDelivery(),before=old('tests/fixtures/current-atlas-delivery.json'),inputs=json('atlas-review/integration-inputs.json'),previous=old('atlas-review/integration-inputs.json');
 assert.equal(pin.source,before.source);assert.equal(pin.sourceTree,before.sourceTree);assert.equal(pin.reviewSourceFiles,before.reviewSourceFiles);
 assert.equal(pin.reviewIntegration,'301707213f9c79bc07eb091870c616bf5f1d413511e19a7e1a2457c9db4581a6');
 const map=new Map(previous.inputs.map(row=>[row.path,row.sha256]));
 assert.deepEqual(inputs.inputs.filter(row=>!map.has(row.path)).map(row=>row.path).sort(),['lib/head-atlas-overlays.ts','lib/head-overlay-loading.ts']);
 assert.deepEqual(inputs.inputs.filter(row=>map.has(row.path)&&map.get(row.path)!==row.sha256).map(row=>row.path).sort(),['components/HeadAtlasViewer.tsx','lib/head-atlas-import.ts','scripts/bind-clinical-review.mjs']);
 for(const row of inputs.inputs)assert.equal(sha(read(row.path)),row.sha256,row.path);
 for(const [p,digest]of Object.entries(before.documents))if(!['atlas-review/manifest.json','atlas-review/integration-inputs.json','public/atlas-review-viewer/manifest.json'].includes(p))assert.equal(sha(read(p)),digest,p);
 assert.match(read('lib/head-atlas-import.ts').toString(),/HEAD_MANIFEST_SHA256 = '0f91f6097e378465827c89a4a10c6ca32ae1bdc276dfbb9c6714527e4f3530c5'/);
});
test('register42 keeps all71 requirements, eight ideas and approval scope',()=>{
 const before=old('docs/completion-checklist.json'),data=json('docs/completion-checklist.json'),pin=validateCurrentAtlasDelivery();
 assert.equal(before.revision,41);assert.equal(data.revision,42);assert.equal(data.items.length,71);assert.equal(data.items.filter(i=>i.scope==='optional').length,8);
 assert.deepEqual(data.changeLog.slice(1),before.changeLog);assert.equal(data.changeLog[0].revision,42);
 assert.deepEqual({...data.baseline,reviewIntegration:before.baseline.reviewIntegration},before.baseline);assert.equal(data.baseline.reviewIntegration,pin.reviewIntegration);assert.deepEqual(data.pendingAtlasSource,before.pendingAtlasSource);
 for(const previous of before.items){const current=data.items.find(item=>item.id===previous.id),{evidence:a,...x}=previous,{evidence:b,...y}=current;assert.deepEqual(y,x);assert.deepEqual(b,['IMG-01','REL-01'].includes(previous.id)?[...a,'website:docs/HEAD_MASK_RESOURCE_BUDGET.md']:a);}
 assert.equal(read('docs/completion-checklist.md').toString(),renderChecklist(data));assert.equal(data.baseline.publicReleaseApproval,null);assert.equal(data.baseline.privateClinicalDecisionCounts,null);
});
test('checksum history retains every original assertion in its exact source epoch',()=>{
 const original=read('tests/fixtures/head-mask-checksum-binding-original.txt');assert.equal(sha(original),'3a40e2200a1d8e6f7e36f4033015fcb3afc8b6b7016bdeb0d6a8bcbf66513b20');
 const from="current=json('tests/fixtures/current-atlas-delivery.json')",to="current=JSON.parse((()=>{const bytes=read('tests/fixtures/current-atlas-delivery-bc925194.json');assert.equal(sha(bytes),'f50171ac10bcf767cc29eb34cae7e873ff526a3940b03a0a59fe6d932cf01eab');return bytes;})())";
 assert.equal(original.toString().split(from).length-1,1);assert.equal(read('tests/head-asset-checksum-binding.test.mjs').toString(),original.toString().replace(from,to));
});
